note: Agent limits (ARCHITECTURE.md D9, D18, D19). max_rounds 2 = the first run plus 1 retry. max_concurrency and time_cap_seconds may give one value per brain, picked by BRAIN. max_concurrency "auto" = the number of SLM hosts in SLM_BASE_URLS x jobs_per_host (config/brains.json), at most max_workers: one host runs one worker at a time, so 1 host gives 1 (ADR D29, D31). daily_budget_usd, queue_max and ticket_cooldown_seconds are for the Jira trigger service (scripts/serve.py, ADR D28).
